title: 18 out of 18: what stocks do after every midterm #shorts
description:
Since 1950, the stock market was higher one year after every midterm election: 18 out of 18, about 18% on average. 2022 fell 18.5% before the vote, then rose about 21% after. Will 2026 make it 19 for 19?

Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/37Aow08f8zk (out Monday, Nov 2)

Data: S&P 500 monthly, Robert Shiller (Yale), price only, October to October, 1950-2018; 2022 measured to September 2023, where the data ends.

This video is for education only and is not financial advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results.
Original script and animation. Some background clips were made with AI (Google Flow). Narrated with an AI voice.
